title: Three Mornings and One Short Pane
subtitle: 天气气候 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）
meta: 主题语境：天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）　|　核心词汇：frost　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 frost 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1969 the gardener ① brushed a frost that no neighbour in the valley would have described, and he said the brushing was the whole of the morning. The ② frost, meaning the ice itself and not the snow, ran three mornings and stayed undescribed in the book; a frost, he said, is the only thing in a valley that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ frost in that valley had the same short pane beside it, and the ④ frost at the far hedge, meaning the one they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A frost, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the gardener said the describing is the part that fills three mornings.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the frost was the whole of the matter, meaning the coldness and not the ice. The ⑥ frost, meaning the coldness and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; frost, he said, is either something you brush or the only word that means both ice and a coldness. He said the coldness is the part they remember.

By 1976 the ⑦ frost had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short pane. The ⑧ frost of the whole thing, the gardener wrote in November, was one valley and three mornings of describing; frost, he said, is either the one at the far hedge or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ frost I remember is the one described in the plan, which closed in 1978 and is still described as the quietest in the valley. A ⑩ frost, my mother said in 1980, is the only one that improves by being described; every frost, she said, is a coldness that has agreed to look like ice. She said the coldness was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 霜（指山谷里每一场旁边的那一场）
B. n. 霜（指那一场本身，与雪相对）
C. 固定搭配：brush a frost 拂去一层霜
D. n. 霜（指留给孩子们的那一层）
E. n. 霜（抽象总称，指一个山谷的结霜之事）
F. n. 霜（指计划里写到、被描述过的那一层）
G. n. 冷淡；冷漠（a frost in manner，指一件事里人人都等却无人说破的那样东西）
H. n. 冷淡（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人说破的那样东西）

items.q: brushed a frost that no neighbour in the valley would have described
The frost, meaning the ice itself and not the snow
the frost at the far hedge
the frost was the whole of the matter
the frost had become a line in a plan
The frost of the whole thing
A frost, my mother said in 1980

answers.why: brush a frost 意为“拂去一层霜”，1969 年那位园丁拂去了一层山谷里没有一位邻居肯描述的霜。
frost 意为“霜”，指那一场本身而不是雪，它经过了三个早晨而在簿子上没有被描述。
frost 意为“霜”，指山谷里每一场旁边的那一场，每一场旁边都有同一块矮矮的窗玻璃。
frost 意为“霜”，指留给孩子们的那一层，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
frost 意为“冷淡、冷漠”，指一件事里人人都等却无人说破的那样东西，叔叔说这份冷淡就是那件事的全部。
frost 意为“冷淡”，指人人都等却无人说破的那样东西而不是那场霜，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
frost 意为“霜”，指计划里写到、被描述过的那一层，到 1976 年这一层成了计划里的一行。
frost 意为“霜”，园丁十一月写道，整件事的结霜之事是一个山谷和三个早晨的描述。
frost 意为“霜”，我记得的是计划里描述过的那一层，1978 年结束了，至今仍被说成山谷里最安静的一层。
frost 为抽象总称，母亲 1980 年说，一场霜是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的东西。
